task_title: Magic Missile VFX: homing arc + light source

plan_review.notes: Adversarial rubber-duck review (gpt-5.4, high effort) rejected the initial plan with 3 blocking + 3 non-blocking concerns + 1 suggestion. All resolved via code changes: (1) BLOCKING damage-bonus overlap: getSpellSkillEfficacyMultiplier now skips SPELL_SKILL_BREAKPOINT_BONUSES for magic-missile specifically since those breakpoints are redirected into extra missiles instead; added a level4-vs-level5 per-hit-damage ratio regression test proving no double-dip. (2) BLOCKING wall-clip risk from forced non-zero launch offset: shrank MAGIC_MISSILE_ARC_OUT_FRAMES 10->6 and MAGIC_MISSILE_ARC_STEP_RAD 0.55->0.35 rad, cutting the off-axis excursion from ~11ft to ~6.6ft, small enough to clear typical corridor/doorway geometry while still reading as a visible arc. (3) BLOCKING fromActiveAbility loss through tagDamageMeta: added fromActiveAbility?:boolean to PersistedDamageMeta/FAIL_CLOSED_DAMAGE_META/tagDamageMeta/readDamageMeta (optional, defaults false, zero new call-site churn), wired castMagicMissile's tagDamageMeta call to pass it through so ability-vs-weapon damage attribution telemetry stays correct; added damage-meta.test.ts round-trip coverage. (4) NON-BLOCKING no retarget-on-death: implemented full retarget-to-nearest-living-enemy in homingSystem when the assigned target dies/is removed, with new regression tests, rather than leaving it as an accepted gap. (5) NON-BLOCKING VFX identity coupled to generic Homing tag: damageSystem now derives the arcaneBoltImpact color from the projectile's own Glowing light instead of a hardcoded Homing-implies-purple constant, decoupling color from the tag; added a color assertion regression test. (6) NON-BLOCKING target-splitting design: confirmed intentional (issue only requires extra missiles, not single-target-only behavior; round-robin spread is classic Magic Missile design); documented explicitly in code comment. (7) SUGGESTION deterministic same-side arc for solo casts: accepted as-is per the repo's no-Math.random()/determinism constraint (rule 3). Alternatives argued by the reviewer (separate Magic-Missile-specific controller; a ProjectileBehavior enum instead of tag components; a scripted deterministic curve instead of physical homing) were considered and rejected: they would duplicate the existing generic projectile/collision/damage pipeline that every other weapon/spell already relies on, at higher long-term maintenance cost. plan_divergence=minor because the core architecture (reuse generic projectile pipeline + new Homing/Glowing tag components + homingSystem) was not overturned -- only parameter tuning and two data-model extensions (fromActiveAbility field, retarget-on-death) were added on top of the original plan.

findings.detail: The real Magic Missile cast test verifies eventual impact but not the defining launch arc or slow speed; zeroing the arc offset/delay would still pass. Assert that a spawned missile initially travels off the target bearing at the intended speed and only begins steering after its activation frame.

independent_grade.notes: The implementation correctly replaces instant damage with deterministic, sim-wired homing projectiles, preserves damage and skill attribution, adds milestone missile counts, and integrates dynamic lighting and impact VFX. Targeted unit, typecheck, lint, wiring, and real-scene lighting tests pass. Coverage is strong, but the cast-level arc and speed contract lacks a direct regression assertion.
